cards.contract: Grupo legacy/gui/session_security.py: 1 archivos. Terminales leido PY """In-memory security boundary for BAXY's loopback GUI.  The browser receives a short-lived, one-use bootstrap secret in the URL fragment.  Fragments are not sent in HTTP requests, so the frontend must exchange it explicitly before any API endpoint becomes available.  The exchange creates an HttpOnly session cookie and returns a CSRF token which is kept only in browser/server memory.
